data.data:
Dear Endministrators:

Arknights: Endfield Game Tools have been updated during the [At the Wake of Spring] version. Check out what's been changed!


Map Tools Update: Real-Time Location Sync Is Now Live!

Map Tools now supports real-time character location sync. After logging into both the game and the SKPORT Map Tools using your Gryphline Account, turn on the [Location Sync] toggle in the bottom-right corner of Map Tools to see your real-time in-game location.

When storage crates or Aurylenes are within a certain range of your real-time location, their respective markers will automatically activate and appear on Map Tools, making exploration and collection easier.

In addition, Map Tools has been updated with the new version's maps and related markers to help you explore the new areas more easily.

Update Notes Link: https://www.skport.com/article?id=2045099462466612739

>>Go to Map Tools<<


Daily Sign-in Tool Update: Limited-Time Sign-In Event Is Now Live!

Sign in daily to get various in-game items. Complete the 7-day sign-in to earn a total of Oroberyl×260!

Update Notes Link: https://www.skport.com/article?id=2046170617914587406

>>Click to Sign In<<


Team Picks & Build Guide Update: New Operator [Zhuang Fangyi] Now Available!

The [Team Picks] and [Build Guide] tool pages have been updated with the new operator [Zhuang Fangyi]! You can easily browse recommended team comps and build strategies shared by other Endmins, or submit your own team comps and build plans to share unique insights with fellow players.

>>Go to Team Picks & Build Guide<<


Protocol Terminal Data Search Tool Update: [Desktop Widget] Now Includes Weekly Routine Data Updates!

The [Desktop Widget] now includes Weekly Routine data. You can set up the [Desktop Widget] to quickly check real-time game data, such as Sanity recovery status and Daily Task progress.

Setup Guide: https://www.skport.com/article?id=2045433122306946853


WIKI Update: New Version Character, Weapon, Items, Facilities and More

With the latest version update, WIKI will feature entries for the new operator [Zhuang Fangyi], new weapon [Lone Barge], and other newly added items, facilities, and gear.

>>Click to Visit WIKI<<


That covers all the tool updates for this new version! We hope these enhancements provide even more support for your journey, Endministrators.

We welcome all Endministrators to use our Game Tools and provide valuable feedback. We will continue to improve the functionality and user experience of each tool. Thank you for your continued support!
